content: If IpduMDevErrorDetect is configured to TRUE, all IpduM APIs shall check their input parameters and report detected errors to DET via Det_ReportErro r . IPDUM_E_PARAM shall be reported for normal parameter s and IPDUM_E_PARAM_POINTER for pointer parameters.

If IpduMDevErrorDetect is configured to TRUE, all IpduM APIs shall check their input parameters and report detected errors to DET via Det_ReportErro r . IPDUM_E_PARAM shall be reported for normal parameter s and IPDUM_E_PARAM_POINTER for pointer parameters.

If IpduMDevErrorDetect is configured to TRUE, all IpduM APIs shall check their input parameters and report detected errors to [9, DET] via Det_ReportError . IPDUM_E_PARAM shall be reported for normal parameters and IPDUM_E_PARAM_POINTER for pointer parameters.
